We have a great selection of trails groomed on both networks this morning! Groomers reporting excellent conditions!  Right now we are planning on a similar groom for tomorrow and then likely staying off the trails with groomers on Sunday.  The weather forecast is trending in the right direction for those of us that live winter! We will lose some trails fore sure (there are already some thin spots out there) but we are confident that we'll be skiing through next week! 50s and sunny, what great spring skiing conditions!! Don't miss it!

Kick of the Day:
Universal klister
